meta.title: EMPOWERALL — Growing the future from the ground up
meta.description: EMPOWERALL brings new generation farmers, researchers, advisors, policymakers and local communities together to co-create agroecological pathways for change.
meta.ogDescription: Growing the future from the ground up. A European project for agroecological transition with new generation farmers.

hero.title: Growing the future from the <accent>ground up</accent>.
hero.description: EMPOWERALL brings new generation farmers, researchers, advisors, policymakers and local communities together to co-create agroecological pathways for change.
hero.distinctive: The Living Labs are embedded in Long-Term Socio-Ecological Research (LTSER) Platforms of eLTER RI.
hero.visualAlt: Researchers walking along agroecological field trial plots.

challenge.title: New generation farmers can drive change. But they cannot do it alone.
challenge.paragraph1: New generation farmers bring new ideas, skills and perspectives to agriculture. But change depends on access to knowledge, resources, networks and opportunities to participate in decision-making.
challenge.paragraph2: EMPOWERALL creates the conditions for them to take a more active role in shaping the future of agriculture.
challenge.visualAlt: Aerial view of agricultural field trials.

access.title: Access
access.body: To land, farm succession, resources and opportunities.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.body: Scientific evidence, local experience and shared learning.

networks.title: Networks
networks.body: Connections between farmers, advisors, communities and institutions.

voice.title: Voice
voice.body: A stronger role in decision-making, governance and policy.

approach.title: From knowledge to action, together.
approach.intro: EMPOWERALL works through collaborative environments where farmers, researchers, advisors, communities and policymakers can explore local challenges, exchange knowledge and co-create solutions.

listen.title: Listen
listen.body: Understand local challenges, experiences and needs.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Bring different people and perspectives together.

cocreate.title: Co-create
cocreate.body: Develop and test agroecological practices, governance models and new ideas.

learn.title: Learn & scale
learn.body: Turn local experience and eLTER long-term observation into knowledge that can travel further, including EU-level policy recommendations.

livingLabs.title: Four places. Shared questions. Different realities.
livingLabs.intro: EMPOWERALL develops four Agroecology Living Labs in Romania, Slovakia, France and Spain. Each Living Lab responds to its own environmental, social and agricultural context, while contributing to a shared goal: advancing agroecological transitions across different territories.
livingLabs.mapLabel: Dotted map of Europe highlighting the Living Labs in Romania, Slovakia, France and Spain.

observation.title: Connecting local action with long-term knowledge.
observation.paragraph1: EMPOWERALL connects the experimentation taking place in the Living Labs with the Long-Term Socio-Ecological Research (LTSER) Platforms of eLTER RI.
observation.paragraph2: By combining local knowledge with monitoring and data collected over time on the LTSER Platforms of eLTER RI, the project can track change, understand how different environmental and social conditions influence results, and build stronger evidence for agroecological solutions.
observation.visualAlt: Aerial view of crop trial plots used for long-term observation.

people.title: Built with people, not just for them.
people.intro: EMPOWERALL brings together different actors so that multiple forms of knowledge and experience can shape the project from the ground up.

partners.title: A European network working across disciplines and territories.
partners.intro: EMPOWERALL brings together partners with expertise in agroecology, farming systems, research, long-term observation, policy, participatory research and stakeholder engagement.
partners.associatedNote: eLTER RI participates as an external advisor through UFZ.
partners.advisoryPlaceholder: An advisory panel will be named in the first six months of the project.
